source_name: Мінфін (minfin.com.ua) — аналітика зарплат банкірів та банківський рейтинг
why_relevant: Publishes derived analyses of bank staff costs and pay growth (using NBU financial statements: personnel expense divided by headcount), giving a usable proxy for sector compensation trends without a commercial salary survey.

source_name: Незалежна асоціація банків України (НАБУ) — комітети та галузеве представництво
why_relevant: Sector association whose committee structure, member list and events map who speaks for banks on regulatory and workforce matters; useful as an actor-map pointer and to reach bank HR practitioners, even though it currently has no dedicated HR committee.

source_name: Кар'єрні сторінки банків (наприклад OTP Bank Ukraine) — прямі вакансії роботодавця
why_relevant: Bank-owned career pages are the primary, unmediated signal of what each institution is actually hiring for (branch vs digital vs risk vs relocation hubs) and reveal organisational restructuring before it is reported.

source_name: Ділові медіа з покриттям скорочення мережі відділень (NV Бізнес, РБК-Україна, OBOZ.UA)
why_relevant: These outlets systematically compute and publish per-bank branch-closure league tables from NBU data, which is the most visible public proxy for retail-staff reduction and organisational restructuring.

First-party newsroom of Ukraine's largest privately-owned commercial bank (SCM group). Publishes dated corporate press releases including management board changes, new business unit launches and senior appointments. Confirmed dated item list with month/year archive filters back to 2023 and earlier.

Authoritative current roster of the management board with roles. Diffing this page over time detects appointments and departures that never get a press release — the cheapest high-signal detector for leadership moves.
Dedicated careers subdomain. Vacancy titles and volumes are a leading indicator of new business units, tech investment and restructuring — often visible months before any press release.

Newsroom of the largest foreign-owned bank in Ukraine (RBI group; formerly Raiffeisen Bank Aval). Publishes appointments, board decisions, AGM outcomes, rebranding and strategy announcements. Has an EN mirror and a filterable news index with category/query parameters.
Press-centre landing page with press-service contacts and the curated press release stream; the media-facing entry point distinct from the general news feed.

source_name: Райффайзен Банк — Керівництво: правління та наглядова рада
why_relevant: Current management board and supervisory board roster with portfolios (e.g. deputy chairman responsible for the operations vertical). Diffing captures appointments/departures and vertical reorganisations.

The bank runs its hiring on an external Workable ATS instance — a clean, structured, machine-readable vacancy feed for the largest foreign-owned bank in UA (5,500+ staff, 800+ IT specialists). Job titles reveal new units and technology bets directly.

Newsroom of the Hungarian OTP Group's Ukrainian subsidiary. Confirmed to carry explicit top-management appointment releases (e.g. 'Нові призначення у команді топ-менеджерів ОТП Банку'), including department-director level moves — exactly the granularity this cell needs. Deep, dated archive (~283 pagination pages).

source_name: ОТП Банк — Банк у ЗМІ (bank in the media)
why_relevant: A bank-curated index of third-party media coverage. Excellent snowball surface: it names which Ukrainian outlets cover this bank, and often links interviews with newly appointed executives that are not in the press-release stream.

source_name: ОТП Банк — Організаційна структура / shareholder-stakeholder information (PDF)
why_relevant: A dated PDF ('Станом на 1 липня 2026 року') containing the bank's full organisational structure. This is the single highest-value artefact for the 'organization changes' topic in this cell: version-to-version diffs expose department creation, merger and elimination, not just named appointments.

Universal Bank is the licensed bank behind monobank. Its newsroom carries CEO-level activity (e.g. CEO Iryna Starominska's public appearances), network expansion and rating news — the first-party record for the monobank partner entity, which is otherwise communicated mostly via Telegram.

source_name: КНЕДП monobank | Universal Bank — Новини (qualified trust service provider notices)
why_relevant: The bank's qualified electronic trust services (КНЕДП/CA) arm publishes its own regulatory notices. Reveals-indirectly: changes of responsible officers, service reorganisation and compliance-driven structural change that never reach the main newsroom.

source_name: Креді Агріколь Банк (Crédit Agricole Ukraine) — Прес-центр / Новини
why_relevant: Newsroom of the French-owned bank; carries CEO interviews and corporate milestones. Directly relevant now: the supervisory board ended Carlos de Cordoue's term and Vitaliy Kucher became acting chairman from 1 July 2026 — a live leadership transition to track at source.
Board roster page — the fastest confirmation of the de Cordoue → Kucher transition and of any further changes. Diffable.

Newsroom of the German ProCredit group's Ukrainian bank (SME and agri focus). Publishes management information (Oleksandr Povshedny as board chairman) and IFI funding deals (e.g. EUR 20m EFSE facility) that typically accompany new business-unit creation and hiring.

Privately-owned retail bank (A24 app). Board chaired by Yuriy Kandaurov since 2015; renamed to Абанк in 2023 and rebranded to àбанк from 16 Sep 2024 — evidence the bank does announce corporate/organisational change. However no dedicated press-centre path was located in this pass; its news appears to be distributed primarily through third-party portals.

source_name: Sense Bank — corporate/newsroom and governance (private-capital successor to Alfa-Bank Ukraine)
why_relevant: Formerly Alfa-Bank Ukraine, a major bank whose ownership status changed; currently the site of intense leadership turbulence — in Aug 2026 the government suspended supervisory board head Mykola Hladyshenko and board chairman Oleksiy Stupak amid the NABU/SAP 'Forest Gump' case, and Peter Novak was appointed an independent supervisory board member. Highest-volatility actor for this cell's topics. Root domain given; specific newsroom path NOT confirmed in this pass.

Maintains a stable per-bank company page and news feed for every actor in this cell (Raiffeisen /aval/, PUMB, monobank, ProCredit, àбанк, Sense Bank, Credit Agricole). Acts as a uniform aggregation layer and is the de facto publication channel for banks like àбанк that have weak own newsrooms.

Second uniform per-bank aggregation layer with the same coverage as Minfin but different editorial pickup; useful for redundancy and for catching items one portal misses. Slug-predictable across all cell actors.

source_name: Forbes.ua — банківські профілі компаній та новини
why_relevant: Maintains numbered company profiles for cell actors (Raiffeisen /523, ProCredit /392) and breaks senior appointment news quickly — it carried the Sense Bank independent supervisory board member appointment (Peter Novak, 25 Aug 2026) as a standalone news item. Good for supervisory-board-level moves that banks under-publicise.

Ukraine's largest general job board; carries listings for every cell actor including those with no structured careers site (àбанк, ProCredit, Credit Agricole). Cyrillic employer-name queries are required — English-only search misses most postings. Hiring volume and role mix reveal restructuring indirectly.
Second major UA job board with stable numeric per-employer company pages (Raiffeisen Bank = company1037), giving a clean per-actor hiring feed independent of the bank's own ATS.

source_name: DOU.ua — Raiffeisen Bank company vacancies (tech hiring)
why_relevant: DOU is the Ukrainian IT community platform. Raiffeisen runs one of the country's largest product IT teams (800+ specialists), and DOU is where banks compete for those hires. Tech job titles are the sharpest available signal for new digital business units and payments-platform builds — directly relevant to a payments intelligence programme.
